visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: All-Negative Input Gives Zero
visualizerParams.problemDescription: For [-4, -1, -8] the best subarray is just -1, but the program prints 0.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
def max_subarray(nums):
    best = 0
    current = nums[0]
    for n in nums[1:]:
        current = max(n, current + n)
        best = max(best, current)
    return best


print(max_subarray([-4, -1, -8]))

solution.code:
def max_subarray(nums):
    best = current = nums[0]
    for n in nums[1:]:
        current = max(n, current + n)
        best = max(best, current)
    return best


print(max_subarray([-4, -1, -8]))
solution.explanation: Starting best at 0 quietly allows an empty subarray with sum 0, which beats every negative sum. A subarray must contain at least one element, so best starts from the first element.
